text:
Yuri Sadovski if you started the process 2 years ago and now you’re switching to A5 (I assume upon recent marriage) and the document accepted at the beginning of the process as far as I know, no need to renew it.
If the document was not accepted and this is the first time you handed it then you should bring an updated one from your original country authenticated. They can check your background in Israel (and they do)
